mapper.sql: id, user_id, receiver_name, phone, province, city, district, detail_address, is_default, created_at, updated_at, create_by, update_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO address (user_id, receiver_name, phone, province, city, district, detail_address, is_default, created_at, updated_at, create_by, update_by) VALUES (#{userId}, #{receiverName}, #{phone}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{detailAddress}, #{isDefault}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM address WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM address WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT
FROM address WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_default DESC, created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE address SET is_default = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_default = 1
